spike_plan.kill_if: Subsystem is under 300 lines or lives outside cx-api; the test suite cannot run offline after a minimal dep set; or two runs of the differential output disagree.
spike_plan.pass_if: Tag and SHA reconciled; subsystem located in aws-cdk-lib/cx-api at 800+ lines; jest runs deterministically and the deleted-subsystem build fails while the original passes.
steps: In a throwaway container with network, clone aws/aws-cdk at v2.274.0 and confirm the head SHA; reconcile 280b8018 with smoke commit ec693779 before anything else.

Read packages/aws-cdk-lib/cx-api/lib (incl. private/) and count lines per file; map which files belong to artifact loading, metadata/context typing and feature flags, and whether loading sits in @aws-cdk/cloud-assembly-api instead.
Install the minimal offline dep set for packages/@aws-cdk/cx-api and packages/aws-cdk-lib/cx-api; run jest there and record per-test results for features.test.ts.
Remove the candidate subsystem in a scratch copy and run the single upstream test file against the original; check it fails and then passes with the original restored.
Generate 20 random manifests and run the original through its public API twice to test determinism of the differential output.
Decide: if the removed subsystem is 800+ lines and the test run is deterministic, keep; if it is under ~300 lines or sits outside cx-api, re-scope or kill K3.

v1.summary: The aws-cdk v2.274.0 tag, Apache-2.0 licence and cx-api package metadata are confirmed, but the seed's package path and test suite are contradicted: the source is in packages/aws-cdk-lib/cx-api with one visible test file, and the smoke probe never ran tests. The card should not be accepted until it is re-scoped to aws-cdk-lib/cx-api and the spike confirms the subsystem size and a deterministic offline suite.
